name: Days between dates
title: Days Between Dates Calculator: Count Days and Business Days
description: Count the days between two dates, with or without the end date, plus business days only. Add or subtract days, weeks or months to find a deadline.
summary: Count days and business days between dates, or add days to find a deadline.
howTo: Count days: pick a start and an end date. Tick Include the end date if both days count, for example for a hotel booking or a leave request.
Read the total days, the same span in weeks and months, and how many of those are business days (Monday to Friday).
Find a date: add or subtract days, weeks, months, years or business days from any date, for example 30 days from an invoice date.

faq.q: Does it count the start date and the end date?
faq.a: By default it counts the days from the start date up to the end date, like the number of nights in a stay. Tick Include the end date to count both days, like the number of days on a holiday.

faq.q: What counts as a business day?
faq.a: Monday to Friday. Public holidays aren't removed, because they differ by country and region, so subtract any that fall in your range.

faq.q: What happens when I add a month to 31 January?
faq.a: You get the last day of February (28 February, or 29 in a leap year), because February has no 31st. Most banks and contracts handle month-end dates the same way.

faq.q: Do time zones or daylight saving change the count?
faq.a: No. The calculator works with calendar dates only, so a clock change never adds or removes a day.
